endpoint: POST /streams/xrpl (called by Quicknode Streams, not by our services)
note: Destination of the Quicknode Stream (XRPL ledger dataset) running the filter in services/credit/quicknode/streams_filter.js. Verified with HMAC-SHA256 over X-QN-Nonce + X-QN-Timestamp + body using QUICKNODE_STREAMS_TOKEN. Gzip bodies are accepted. Also accepts an unfiltered ledger payload ({ data: [ledger, ...] }) and filters it locally against the watchlist. Returns 2xx so Quicknode does not retry; returns 401 on a bad signature.
